example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বসের রামের হনুমানের মতো অনুগত।
এই প্রকল্পে সে রামের হনুমানের ভূমিকা পালন করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is as loyal to his boss as Ram's Hanuman.
In this project, he is playing the role of Ram's Hanuman.
history: This idiom draws from the Ramayana epic, where Hanuman is portrayed as the ultimate devotee of Lord Rama, symbolizing unwavering loyalty and service.
note: Rooted in Hindu mythology, commonly used in Bengali to denote blind or extreme loyalty.
